# Synthetic, in the shape of alec.org's (read 2026-11-15), which is Yoast's block with an empty
# Disallow, allowing every path. The withheld-lamp-act line is invented, so a test can see a
# disallowed policy reported; it comes first because Python's parser applies the first rule that
# fits, and it reads the empty Disallow as allowing everything.
# START YOAST BLOCK
User-agent: *
Disallow: /model-policy/withheld-
Disallow:

Sitemap: https://alec.org/sitemap_index.xml
# END YOAST BLOCK
